quotes.text: Build an onramp flow native to your app or website with components that provide authentication and secure data collection, tailored to your design.
[Quickstart](https://docs.stripe.com/crypto/onramp/embedded-components-quickstart.md): Run minimal code to see the full onramp flow and learn about the integration.
[Integration guide](https://docs.stripe.com/crypto/onramp/embedded-components-integration-guide.md): Follow step-by-step instructions to integrate for Web, React Native, Android, and iOS.
[EU KYC integration guide](https://docs.stripe.com/crypto/onramp/eu-kyc-integration-guide.md): Integrate KYC for customers in EU countries.
[Error handling](https://docs.stripe.com/crypto/onramp/embedded-components-error-handling-guide.md): Handle errors that occur during onramp sessions.

old_evidence.text: This quickstart runs minimal code for the full flow.
All backend requests to the Stripe API must include the `Stripe-Version` header with the `crypto_onramp_beta=v2` flag:
Store the access token and use it in the `Stripe-OAuth-Token` header for all subsequent crypto API calls from your backend. Don't expose the access token to the client.
Checkout will return an HTTP 400 response if you checkout with an expired quote.
